neighbours.label: the start of a split form of 'survey' (' Sur'|veys, ' SUR'|VEYOR, re'-s'|urvey)
fire: Recent national Surveys of more than 3,000 households show rising rents.
The county hired a team to re-survey the old farm boundaries.
A LICENSED BUILDING SURVEYOR MUST SIGN OFF ON THE PLANS.
Annual Health Surveys have tracked smoking rates since the 1960s.
Earlier Surveys of the reef found far more coral than today.
After the flood, engineers had to re-survey the whole river bank.
THE CHIEF SURVEYOR ARRIVED ON SITE EARLY ON MONDAY.
Two Surveys carried out last spring gave very different results.
quiet: Recent national studies of more than 3,000 households show rising rents.
The county hired a team to fence the old farm boundaries.
A LICENSED BUILDING INSPECTOR MUST SIGN OFF ON THE PLANS.
Annual health reports have tracked smoking rates since the 1960s.
Earlier dives on the reef found far more coral than today.
After the flood, engineers had to rebuild the whole river bank.
THE CHIEF ENGINEER ARRIVED ON SITE EARLY ON MONDAY.
Two experiments carried out last spring gave very different results.

notes: Card: ' Sur' x3, '-s' x2 (re-survey), ' SUR'VEYOR, 'Ordnance' before Survey; the opposite output direction promotes survey/poll words. Tokenizer: ' Surveys' = ' Sur'+'veys', ' SURVEYOR' = ' SUR'+..., ' re-survey' = ' re'+'-s'+'urvey'; ' Survey' and ' surveyor' do not split this way, so fire items use the split forms. Near misses use other words for studies/inspectors.
